title: Golden Mushroom Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired pilaf dish made with golden rice, mushrooms, and spices. This recipe is perfect for a quick and easy weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat kissed oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add dried mushrooms, golden Dutch rice, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Cook for 1-2 minutes, until the rice is lightly toasted.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the water has been absorbed and the rice is tender.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork to separate the grains.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
